name: csvql-query
description: Run SQL on CSV files in place. Query large CSV files fast with no import and no database. A CSV SQL engine in Zig with SIMD parsing, for Node and AI agents (MCP). Read only by design.

scripts.build: zig build node -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && mkdir -p binaries && cp ../zig-out/lib/csvql.node binaries/$(node -p "process.platform + '-' + process.arch").node
